summary: Group bill create assignment sheet did not make quantity/exact/share split basis editable or understandable.
resolution: Mobile assignment sheet now exposes exact amount and share-weight inputs, relabels quantity as unit/share weights, and blocks invalid apply states locally.

summary: Group bill payer step was unfriendly for the common one-person-paid-first flow.
resolution: Mobile payer step now defaults the current active user to the full item total when available and adds payer quick actions.

summary: Group bill submit showed an unsupported request validation failure from a locally ready-looking draft.
resolution: Mobile generated create mapping now omits blank equal-split basisValue keys instead of serializing explicit null values; widget and generated repository tests cover valid one-item split/payer create payloads.

summary: Receipt & Items exposed raw split payload controls and lacked clear quantity/units semantics.
resolution: Mobile group bill create now keeps Receipt & Items focused on item details with a line-total amount label and local quantity/units guidance, removes raw split-entry controls from item cards, and keeps split assignment in the Split step.
